# conjur_swa_node_group (Resource)

Manages an SWA Node Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Minimal node group (unix workload, no workload configuration)
resource "conjur_swa_node_group" "unix_nodes" {
  trust_domain_name = "prod.example.org"
  server_group_name = "prod-servers"
  name              = "prod-nodes"
  workload_type     = "unix"
  description       = "Production unix workload node group"
}

# Node group with a custom SPIFFE ID template and registration policies
resource "conjur_swa_node_group" "k8s_nodes" {
  trust_domain_name = "prod.example.org"
  server_group_name = "k8s-servers"
  name              = "k8s-nodes"
  workload_type     = "kubernetes"
  description       = "Kubernetes workload node group"

  workload_configuration = {
    spiffe_id_template = "spiffe://{{ .trustdomain }}/{{ .nodegroup }}/{{ .k8s.ns }}/{{ .k8s.sa }}"
    workload_registration_policies = [
      "workload.k8s.ns == 'app'",
    ]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the node group. Must be 1-60 characters and may include letters, numbers, periods, underscores, and hyphens only.
- `server_group_name` (String) The name of the server group.
- `trust_domain_name` (String) The name of the trust domain.
- `workload_type` (String) Type of workload for this node group. Valid values: 'unix', 'kubernetes'.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the node group.
- `workload_configuration` (Attributes) Workload configuration for the node group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workload_configuration))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the node group.

<a id="nestedatt--workload_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workload_configuration`

Optional:

- `spiffe_id_template` (String) SPIFFE ID template for workload identification. Uses Go template syntax.
- `workload_registration_policies` (List of String) List of CEL expressions for workload registration policies.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import conjur_swa_node_group.my_node_group prod.example.org/prod-servers/prod-nodes
```
